title: 第19章 河畔渔翁画中仙第20章 殴打
slug: 苟在仙宗打铁悄悄修成道祖
lines: 李牧火学习炼器以来，从未锻造出过极品凡器。
他也曾问过师父，可就连师父也说自己从未锻造出过极品凡器，只说极品凡器需得天时地利人和，才有可能锻造出来。
至于在市面上流通的那些极品凡器，据说最低也是二阶炼器师才能炼出来的。
不过，现在李牧火懂了。
所谓的极品和上品之间，唯一的问题就在瑕疵的多少。
只是，这一刻他心底却生出了另一个问题，那若是一柄武器没有瑕疵呢？算什么品阶？
当然，当下即便李牧火可以看到瑕疵，却也没法做到百分百无瑕疵，或许等他锤法和工具提升后，可以试试。
“我回来了。”
便在这时，林越的声音忽然响起，带着几分难得的兴奋。
李牧火忙出去迎接，却见林越竟是御剑而来，只是御剑手法尚不熟练，应该是这几日刚学的。
“师兄，考上了吗？”
李牧火手里还拎着锤子，略显激动的问道。
“你说呢？”
林越此刻意气风发，加上他本身独特的贵气，竟给人一种别样的傲气。
“自然是考上了。”
李牧火笑呵呵道。
“那你还问。”
说罢，林越跳下飞剑。
这时，杨开山，钱朵朵和陈功也都相继出门，只是几人脸上依旧带着一丝沉闷郁气。
“恭喜师兄考入外门，今天给你杀一只金羽鸡。”
钱朵朵还好，是笑着说话的，只是杨开山和陈功却是根本笑不出来。
陈功勉强挤出一丝难看的笑容道：“恭喜。”
“回来便多住几天，要不然这一去，还不知何时能再见。”
杨开山也勉强露出笑容，声音有些低沉，不复往日爽朗。
林越平日多细心的人，立即便察觉到不对，脸上的一抹喜色迅速收敛，疑惑地看向李牧火道：“我不在的期间，究竟发生了何事？”
却听李牧火轻叹一声，这才将师父和大师兄返回凡尘俗世的事情告诉他。
林越闻言，眉头皱起，许久才道：“也是，人生无不散之筵席，只可惜未能见师父和大师兄最后一面，甚憾。”
李牧火又问：“那你呢？何时去外门报到？”
林越此刻已经恢复了往日的从容和平静，淡淡道：“一个月内去报到即可。”
短暂沉默了一会儿，林越忽然对着众人道：“那么，钓鱼去？”
“行，好久没钓了，今天我定赢你。”
陈功自知修行比不过林越，但在钓鱼这事儿上，他却赢过很多次，所以只要林越参与，他是必去的。
钱朵朵则笑着道：“那今天我们做全鱼宴如何？”
“甚好，甚好。”
李牧火适时地咂巴了一下嘴，配合着钱朵朵。
content_en:
Since Li Muhuo learned to refine weapons, he has never forged a top-quality mortal weapon.
He also asked his master, but even his master said that he had never forged a top-quality mortal weapon. He only said that a top-quality mortal weapon requires the right time, place, and people before it could be forged.
As for the top-grade mortal weapons circulating in the market, it is said that they can only be made by a second-level weapon refiner at the very least.
But now Li Muhuo understands.
The only problem between the so-called top quality and top quality is the number of flaws.
However, at this moment, another question arose in his heart, what if a weapon was flawless? What kind of grade is it?
Of course, even if Li Muhuo can see the flaws at the moment, he can't make it 100% flawless. Maybe he can try it after his hammering skills and tools improve.
"I'm back."
At this moment, Lin Yue's voice suddenly sounded, with a bit of rare excitement.
Li Muhuo hurriedly went out to greet him, only to see Lin Yue coming with a sword. However, he was not yet proficient in the sword-wielding technique. He must have just learned it in the past few days.
"Senior brother, have you passed the exam?"
Li Muhuo asked slightly excitedly, still holding the hammer in his hand.
"What do you think?"
Lin Yue was in high spirits at the moment, and coupled with his own unique nobility, he actually gave people a different kind of arrogance.
"Of course I passed the exam."
Li Muhuo said with a smile.
"Then you still ask."
After saying that, Lin Yue jumped down from the flying sword.
At this time, Yang Kaishan, Qian Duoduo and Chen Gong also went out one after another, but there was still a trace of depression on their faces.
"Congratulations, senior brother, for being admitted to the outer sect. I will kill a golden-feathered chicken for you today."
Qian Duoduo was okay and spoke with a smile, but Yang Kaishan and Chen Gong couldn't laugh at all.
Chen Gong forced out an ugly smile and said, "Congratulations."
"When you come back, stay for a few more days. Otherwise, I don't know when I can see you again."
Yang Kaishan also forced a smile, his voice was a little low and no longer cheerful as before.
Lin Yue, who was usually very attentive, immediately noticed something was wrong. The joy on his face quickly faded, and he looked at Li Muhuo doubtfully and said, "What happened during my absence?"
But he heard Li Muhuo sigh softly, and then told him about the return of master and senior brother to the mortal world.
When Lin Yue heard this, he frowned and said after a long time: "That's right, all the feasts in life come to an end. It's a pity that I couldn't see my master and senior brother for the last time. It's a pity."
Li Muhuo asked again: "What about you? When will you report to the outer gate?"
Lin Yue had now returned to his usual calmness and calmness, and said calmly: "Just report in within a month."
After a short silence, Lin Yue suddenly said to everyone: "So, are you going fishing?"
"Okay, I haven't fished for a long time, I will definitely beat you today."
Chen Gong knew that he could not compare with Lin Yue in practice, but he had won many times in fishing, so as long as Lin Yue participated, he would definitely go.
Qian Duoduo smiled and said, "How about we make a fish feast today?"
"Very good, very good."
Li Muhuo smacked his lips in time and cooperated with Qian Duoduo.
